description: Sends messages to any chat model id through POST /v1/chat/completions and returns the answer, the token usage and what the request cost. system adds instructions, image_urls lets a model that sees images look at them (a file generate made works), web_search lets the model search while it answers. Billed to the key in the MCP request's Authorization header (Bearer sk-unr-live-...); without one it fails.

image_urls.description: Image URLs attached to the last user message, for the chat models that take images (input_modalities in list_models). A file generate made works.

model.description: A chat model id from list_models.

system.description: Instructions placed ahead of the conversation as a system message.

web_search.description: True: the model may search the web while it answers (billed per search, the price in GET /v1/catalog server_tools).

name: chat
title: Send a chat request
